features.name: v1_zscore
features.description: Z-score normalized recency of last donation (V1), centering and scaling for distance computation
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes V1 to unit variance so it contributes proportionally in Euclidean distance calculations

features.name: v2_zscore
features.description: Z-score normalized frequency of donations (V2), centering and scaling for distance computation
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes V2 to unit variance so it contributes proportionally in Euclidean distance calculations

features.name: v3_zscore
features.description: Z-score normalized total blood donated in cc (V3), centering and scaling for distance computation
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes V3 to unit variance so it contributes proportionally in Euclidean distance calculations

features.name: v4_zscore
features.description: Z-score normalized months since first donation (V4), centering and scaling for distance computation
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes V4 to unit variance so it contributes proportionally in Euclidean distance calculations

features.name: mahalanobis_approx
features.description: Approximate Mahalanobis distance from the training centroid using diagonal covariance (sum of squared z-scores)
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures how far a point is from the overall data center in a scale-invariant way, improving neighborhood geometry

features.name: donation_rate
features.description: Ratio of donation frequency to total tenure (V2 / V4), representing average donation rate over time
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures behavioral intensity as a single normalized ratio, reducing redundancy between V2 and V4 for distance metrics

features.name: log_total_donated
features.description: Log-transformed total blood donated (log1p of V3), compressing the heavy right tail for better distance behavior
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces skewness in V3 so large donors do not dominate distance calculations disproportionately

features.name: recency_frequency_ratio
features.description: Ratio of recency (V1) to frequency (V2), indicating how long since last donation relative to total donations
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes the recency-frequency interaction as a single feature, improving separation in KNN neighborhood

features.name: cc_per_donation
features.description: Average blood volume per donation (V3 / V2), representing consistency of donation amount
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures per-donation volume consistency; donors with similar per-donation volumes cluster together

features.name: recency_tenure_ratio
features.description: Ratio of recency (V1) to total tenure (V4), indicating how recently donated relative to total history length
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes recency by tenure length, creating a relative recency measure that improves neighborhood geometry

features.name: overall_activity_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of overall donor activity level combining recency, frequency, and volume signals into a composite score from 0 (inactive) to 1 (highly active)
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic activity signal that helps KNN identify similar behavioral profiles across multiple dimensions

features.name: donation_regularity_index
features.description: Semantic assessment of how regular and consistent the donation pattern is, based on the relationship between frequency, tenure, and recency; scored 0 (irregular) to 1 (very regular)
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures regularity patterns that group similar donors together in KNN space, improving neighborhood purity
